title: Driver pool allocator and WaveRT CodecDelay warning cleanup

summary.behavior: operator new now uses ExAllocatePool3 with POOL_FLAG_PAGED / POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED (default non-executable, same pool class and 'ibiH' tag); GetHWLatency reports the per-buffer latency estimate in HWLatency->CodecDelay instead of discarding it.
summary.scope_boundary: Source + local WDK build + Inf2Cat signability only. No guest installation, driver load, PnP start, audio delivery, HLK or Microsoft signing claim.

validation.result: pass; HibikiVirtualAudio.sys linked; Inf2Cat 0 errors / 0 warnings

limits: Remaining build output shows C4083 warnings from MSVC 18 vcruntime.h/stdint.h headers and one pre-existing LNK4042 duplicate guids.obj note; both are toolchain noise present across all files, unrelated to this change.
CodecDelay is a per-buffer estimate at buffer granularity; it does not claim measured end-to-end device latency.
next_safe_action: Open PR for maintainer review; optional follow-up to suppress toolchain-header C4083 noise in build flags if desired.
